scope: Independent evidence audit of completed B-H1 and B-H6 OpenFOAM 2D results; reusable gate for B-H3

overall.reason: The refined B-H3 run is still active and B-H1/B-H6 interface kinematics are not quantitatively aligned.

uniform_rules.supported: absolute relative error <= 10%, or an exact qualitative match
uniform_rules.partial: 10% < absolute relative error <= 30%, or only part of a qualitative sequence matches
uniform_rules.failed: absolute relative error > 30%, or the modeled behavior contradicts the published behavior
uniform_rules.missing: no genuinely comparable experimental or model quantity
uniform_rules.classification: finite liquid passage across the physical riser rim using the common stored-field outlet gate
uniform_rules.catchup_proxy: first three consecutive samples with Yfs-Yint <= max(2% initial post-arrival gap, 2 riser dz)
uniform_rules.event_end: earliest of physical-rim crossing, catch-up proxy, or completed observation end
uniform_rules.average_speed: endpoint displacement divided by the common event duration

source_separation.published_measurement: Cong et al. (2017) Table 2 and exact-run figures/prose
source_separation.figure_digitization: values recovered from a rendered published graph and labelled approximate
source_separation.parameter_matched_companion: B-1 or B-32 has the same D, Dr, H0 and L0 but is not B-H1 or B-H6
source_separation.two_dimensional_derivation: centreline alpha=0.5 crossings, gas-fraction-weighted pocket pressure, PT1 probe, or physical-rim surface integration
source_separation.not_directly_comparable: raw 2D per-extrusion flux/volume is not compared to circular experimental discharge or volume

parameter_identity.supported: D=0.05 m, case Dr, H0=0.66 m, L0=0.61 m, paper axial layout, atmospheric initial pocket, constant-head Series B inlet, quiescent start, 23 degC properties, and approximately 0.20 s opening
parameter_identity.limitations: The calculation is planar area-equivalent; the sine-squared Forchheimer valve path, 0.001 minimum aperture, laminar closure, thermophysical details, and finite atmosphere box are model choices not specified by the paper.

classification.evidence: resolved alpha-supported upward liquid component plus cumulative positive liquid volume across z=1.8250001 m

ejection_time.experimental_basis: B-H1 Fig. 8(d)/Fig. 9(a), approximately the first top-reaching frame

interface_kinematics.comparability: partial because the paper does not disclose the exact averaging implementation; the model values use one fixed endpoint formula

exact_BH1_numeric_H_over_H0_peak.reason: Fig. 10(a) is Run B-1, not B-H1.

exact_BH1_mechanism.paper: rapid late acceleration and strong compression/surge before ejection
exact_BH1_mechanism.model: vertical-pocket Ha/Lw median 1.019, p05-p95 1.004-1.034; no resolved compression surge before the much later ejection

event_sequence.failed_or_missing: partial-entry compression, pressure drop followed by sharp surge, and rapid gas/free-surface acceleration are not reproduced

B-H1.basic_alignment_claim: Supported only for arrival and final geyser/ejection outcome; not supported for transient timing, speed, compression, or mechanism.

break_or_catchup_time.note: The model proxy is grid-resolved and common to all cases; it is not claimed identical to visual break identification.

interface_kinematics.comparability: partial because the paper does not disclose the exact averaging implementation; the model values use one fixed endpoint formula

exact_BH6_hydrostatic_pocket_relation.qualification: Paper values are figure-digitized; model values are gas-fraction-weighted centreline gas pressure.

exact_BH6_numeric_H_over_H0_peak.reason: Fig. 10(b) is Run B-32, not B-H6.

event_sequence.matched: arrival -> Taylor-like hydrostatic rise -> gas approaches/catches free surface within the riser -> no rim ejection through 20 s
event_sequence.bias: the rise/break stage is too slow and too low, followed by longer internal oscillation

B-H6.basic_alignment_claim: Supported for no-geyser classification, arrival, qualitative stage order, and hydrostatic pocket pressure; not supported for interface speeds or break timing.

required_inputs: normal solver End at 20 s with no true FOAM FATAL or NaN
complete from-zero stored trajectory and PT1 series
actual case configuration and paper-contract audit
centreline alpha.water, p and U samples
apply_without_change: same catch-up proxy and event endpoint
same endpoint-average vfs, vint and vnet formula
published_evidence_missing_for_exact_BH3: pressure peak or pressure time series
B-H3_reusable_gate.consequence: For B-H3, classification, Ta and Table-2 velocities can be judged quantitatively. Rim time and pressure peak must remain missing rather than borrowing B-H1/B-1 values.
